method_notes: Royal Borough of Greenwich admission arrangements (as summarised in 'Primary Schools in Royal Greenwich 2025/26', 'Admission terms - Distance', p47, and on the council's 'Primary school offers map' page): schools that use home-to-school distance measure a straight line from the centre of the home address to the centre of the school site. Exception: James Wolfe measures from the home to the former Greenwich Town Hall, Meridian House, Royal Hill SE10. Tie-break: where applicants are equidistant, or in a multi-occupancy building, the place is decided by random allocation. Common criteria for community schools and the listed academies: EHCP; looked after/previously looked after; medical/social need; siblings; children of staff; distance. Split-site rules (booklet p49): Bannockburn measured to the High Street site; Heronsgate to the Thamesmead site; Invicta, Plumcroft and Windrush to the site nearest the home; St Thomas a Becket to the Mottisfont Road site; St Mary Magdalene by site applied for. Faith schools (VA/Catholic academies) have their own arrangements; CE schools publish 'Open band' distances only.

gaps: 2025 figures not obtained: they would be in the 2026/27 booklet, which was not found online (the council now hosts the booklet only in a PageSuite reader showing the current 2027/28 edition, and the archived offers-map file from Aug 2025 still held 2024 data), so 2023 figures were added and every school's 2025 entry is not_published. Greenwich publishes a 'distance of last offer' for every school, including undersubscribed ones (e.g. Horn Park 2024: 65 applications for 60 places, 5723 m), and never 'all offered', so large values (e.g. Horn Park 13590.95 m, Cherry Orchard 12490.13 m in 2026) probably reflect the furthest offer made, not a real cut-off; recorded as printed. The 2027/28 booklet labels the 2026 figures 'for entry 2027'; they match the offers-map file labelled 2026. The archived 2024 map file disagreed with the booklet for Heronsgate (53781.35 vs 6907), Bishop John Robinson (21437.68 vs 2955) and Christ Church SE10 (1084.6 vs 4728), so booklet values were used; this suggests the 2026 map file (no independent source) could have similar errors. 2024 values are rounded to whole metres in the booklet. 2023 values come from a text PDF where some numbers ran into page numbers (e.g. Discovery '175816 17' read as 1758) - checked against page images for a sample only. 12 RC/CE faith schools have no published distance (not_published) and their own policies were not checked. Gallions Mount (on the 2026 map with no figure) and Holy Family RC are excluded as no longer open per GIAS. PAN = 'Reception places' in the 2025/26 booklet (Discovery and Montbelle PANs reduced from Sept 2026). Postcodes from the booklet/GIAS; split-site schools have one entry per site that admits Reception separately.
